meta.title: AndastandC# — Skill Tree
meta.note: Big nodes = chapters (modules). Small nodes = topics (day-blocks). Diamonds = crossroads. Hexagons = checkpoints / project defenses. Progress is tracked by the app, not stored here.

nodes.label: START
nodes.summary: Your entry point. Work down the core spine, then pick a specialization at the crossroad.

nodes.label: C# Fundamentals
nodes.summary: Where C# differs from C/Java: value vs reference types, nullability, patterns, the Try-pattern. Interviewers screen on this in the first 10 minutes.

nodes.label: Value vs reference
nodes.summary: struct (copied) vs class (shared); stack vs heap; == semantics; boxing.

nodes.label: Nullability & patterns
nodes.summary: Nullable reference types, switch expressions, property/relational patterns — no if-chains.

nodes.label: Methods & the C-corner
nodes.summary: Try-pattern, ref/out, optional & named params, extension methods, tuples.

nodes.label: Errors & IO
nodes.summary: Typed exceptions (never bare catch), exit codes, robust CLI, first xUnit tests.

nodes.label: Mini-project: C→C# port
nodes.summary: Port a small C program to idiomatic C#: properties, records, nullable-clean, typed errors, tests.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 1
nodes.summary: Closed-book, timed, no AI. Prove you can write idiomatic fundamentals from scratch.

nodes.label: OOP
nodes.summary: Encapsulation, inheritance vs composition, interfaces, polymorphism, records. Model behavior, not just data.

nodes.label: Encapsulation & properties
nodes.summary: Access modifiers, auto-properties, init-only, invariants over public fields.

nodes.label: Inheritance & polymorphism
nodes.summary: abstract/virtual/override, base calls, when to prefer composition.

nodes.label: Interfaces & abstraction
nodes.summary: Program to interfaces, default members, dependency-friendly design.

nodes.label: Records & value equality
nodes.summary: record vs class, with-expressions, immutability, value-based equality.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 2
nodes.summary: Design a small type hierarchy from scratch under time.

nodes.label: Collections & Generics
nodes.summary: List/Dictionary/HashSet and when each; generics; iterators; equality & comparers. The data structures you use every day.

nodes.label: The core collections
nodes.summary: List, Dictionary, HashSet, Queue/Stack — Big-O and the right tool.

nodes.label: Generics & constraints
nodes.summary: Generic methods/types, where-constraints, why generics beat object.

nodes.label: Iterators & equality
nodes.summary: yield return, IEnumerable, IEquatable, custom comparers.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 3
nodes.summary: Pick correct structures and implement generic code cold.

nodes.label: LINQ
nodes.summary: The query language inside C#: pipelines, deferred execution, GroupBy/Join/SelectMany. Unlocks project p1.

nodes.label: The core five + pipelines
nodes.summary: Where, Select, OrderBy, First/Single, Aggregate — composing pipelines.

nodes.label: Deferred execution
nodes.summary: The interview day: lazy evaluation, multiple enumeration, ToList timing.

nodes.label: GroupBy, Join, SelectMany
nodes.summary: Grouping, joining sequences, flattening — real reporting queries.

nodes.label: Delegates & events
nodes.summary: Delegates, events and the publish/subscribe pattern — the callback types lambdas, LINQ and async all build on.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 4
nodes.summary: Write non-trivial LINQ (GroupBy/Join) from memory.

nodes.label: Project 1 — Console Analyzer
nodes.summary: Ship a LINQ-powered console data tool. Defense: explain it to Claude Code — why these queries, where deferred execution bit you.

nodes.label: Async / Await
nodes.summary: Task, async/await, cancellation, parallelism and the classic gotchas (deadlocks, async void). Concurrency without the pain.

nodes.label: Tasks & await
nodes.summary: Task vs Thread, await mechanics, async all the way.

nodes.label: Cancellation & parallelism
nodes.summary: CancellationToken, Task.WhenAll, Parallel, throttling.

nodes.label: Async gotchas
nodes.summary: Deadlocks, async void, ConfigureAwait, exception flow.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 5
nodes.summary: Concurrency exam — build correct async code cold.

nodes.label: SPECIALIZE
nodes.summary: C# fluency proven. Now branch — not either/or, just separation of concerns to streamline your focus. Backend gets you hired; Cloud makes you deployable; Game is where you want to build.

nodes.label: ASP.NET Core
nodes.summary: Minimal APIs, middleware, DI, model binding & validation, ProblemDetails, OpenAPI. Builds project p2's skeleton.

nodes.label: Hosting & minimal API
nodes.summary: The host, endpoints, routing, the request pipeline.

nodes.label: Middleware & DI
nodes.summary: Middleware order, service lifetimes (transient/scoped/singleton).

nodes.label: Binding, DTOs & validation
nodes.summary: Model binding, DTO boundaries, data annotations / FluentValidation.

nodes.label: Errors & ProblemDetails
nodes.summary: Consistent error responses, exception middleware, RFC 7807.

nodes.label: Config, logging, OpenAPI, tests
nodes.summary: Configuration, structured logging, Swagger/OpenAPI, integration tests.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 6
nodes.summary: Build a small API with DI + validation from scratch.

nodes.label: SQL + EF Core
nodes.summary: Relational modeling, EF Core, migrations, relationships, transactions. Puts p2 on a real Postgres database.

nodes.label: SQL foundations
nodes.summary: Write real SQL by hand — SELECT / JOIN / GROUP BY, aggregates & subqueries; CREATE/ALTER tables, keys, indexes, transactions — then read the SQL EF Core generates for you.

nodes.label: EF Core modeling & migrations
nodes.summary: DbContext, entities, conventions, code-first migrations.

nodes.label: Querying & relationships
nodes.summary: LINQ-to-SQL translation, includes, tracking vs no-tracking, N+1.

nodes.label: Transactions & performance
nodes.summary: Unit of work, transactions, query performance, projections.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 7
nodes.summary: Model + migrate + query a schema cold.

nodes.label: Auth (N + Z)
nodes.summary: Authentication (JWT), authorization (policies/roles), Identity, security hardening. Locks p2 down.

nodes.label: Authentication & JWT
nodes.summary: Tokens, claims, the auth middleware, login flow.

nodes.label: Authorization
nodes.summary: Roles, policies, resource-based authorization.

nodes.label: Security hardening
nodes.summary: Hashing, secrets, HTTPS, common OWASP pitfalls.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 8
nodes.summary: Secure an endpoint end-to-end under time.

nodes.label: Project 2 — Data-backed API
nodes.summary: Build a real REST API on Postgres with EF Core — model the schema, migrations, relationships, transactions — then lock it down with JWT auth. Defense: justify your schema + indexes and show Claude Code where you killed N+1.

nodes.label: Deployment
nodes.summary: Docker, CI/CD, public HTTPS, monitoring. Puts p2 live on the internet. (Bridges into the Cloud branch.)

nodes.label: Docker & images
nodes.summary: Dockerfile for .NET, multi-stage builds, running containers.

nodes.label: CI/CD
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions pipeline: build, test, publish.

nodes.label: Hosting, HTTPS & monitoring
nodes.summary: Deploy target, TLS, health checks, logs/metrics.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 9
nodes.summary: Containerize + deploy a service cold.

nodes.label: Capstone
nodes.summary: Repeat the whole arc solo, bigger, against a formal spec. Your portfolio centerpiece — deployed and documented.

nodes.label: Spec & design
nodes.summary: Write the spec, model the domain, plan the build.

nodes.label: Build & test
nodes.summary: Implement the vertical slices with tests and CI.

nodes.label: Ship & document
nodes.summary: Deploy, write the README, polish for reviewers.

nodes.label: Checkpoint 10 (rubric)
nodes.summary: Capstone rubric review.

nodes.label: Project 3 — Capstone Defense
nodes.summary: The big one. Defense: hand the repo to Claude Code — explain every architectural choice like I'm 5, and justify why not the alternatives.

nodes.label: Cloud & Azure Foundations
nodes.summary: The cloud model, Azure portal + CLI, resource groups, RBAC, cost. Orientation before you deploy.

nodes.label: Cloud model & Azure map
nodes.summary: IaaS/PaaS/serverless, regions, the service landscape.

nodes.label: Portal, CLI & resource model
nodes.summary: az CLI, resource groups, ARM, tagging.

nodes.label: Identity, RBAC & cost
nodes.summary: Entra ID basics, role assignments, budgets/cost alerts.

nodes.label: Containers
nodes.summary: Containerize your .NET app properly and push it to a registry — the unit cloud deploys.

nodes.label: Dockerize .NET
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Dockerfile, small images, non-root, healthchecks.

nodes.label: Registries (ACR)
nodes.summary: Azure Container Registry, tags, pull secrets.

nodes.label: Azure Compute
nodes.summary: Run your app on Azure: App Service, Functions (serverless), and Container Apps. Pick the right host.

nodes.label: App Service
nodes.summary: Deploy a web API, slots, scaling, config.

nodes.label: Azure Functions
nodes.summary: Serverless triggers/bindings, isolated worker, when to use.

nodes.label: Container Apps
nodes.summary: Managed containers, ingress, revisions, scale-to-zero.

nodes.label: Cloud Checkpoint 1
nodes.summary: Deploy a containerized API to Azure compute from scratch.

nodes.label: Storage & Config
nodes.summary: Persist and configure at cloud scale: Blob, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, and messaging (Service Bus/Queues).

nodes.label: Blob & Cosmos DB
nodes.summary: Object storage, NoSQL modeling, SDK usage from C#.

nodes.label: Key Vault & config
nodes.summary: Secrets, managed identity, app configuration.

nodes.label: Messaging
nodes.summary: Service Bus / Storage Queues, async decoupling.

nodes.label: CI/CD & IaC
nodes.summary: Automate everything: GitHub Actions pipelines, Bicep infrastructure-as-code, monitoring with App Insights.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions to Azure
nodes.summary: Build/test/deploy pipeline, OIDC auth, environments.

nodes.label: Infrastructure as Code (Bicep)
nodes.summary: Declarative infra, repeatable environments.

nodes.label: Monitoring
nodes.summary: Application Insights, logs, metrics, alerts.

nodes.label: Cloud Checkpoint 2
nodes.summary: Stand up an environment via IaC + pipeline, cold.

nodes.label: AI-Integrated Cloud
nodes.cert: AI-200 (Azure AI Cloud Developer) — the AZ-204 successor
nodes.summary: Where Azure dev is heading: call Azure OpenAI / AI services from C#, and build a simple RAG feature. Note: AZ-204 retires 2026-07-31; AI-200 is the successor (AI-focused; verify current language coverage).

nodes.label: Azure OpenAI & AI services
nodes.summary: Call models/services from .NET, prompts, safety.

nodes.label: RAG basics
nodes.summary: Embeddings, vector search, grounding an API in your data.

nodes.label: Cloud Cert Track
nodes.summary: Cert guidance node: AZ-204 (retires 2026-07-31) → AI-200. Defense: hand your deployed cloud project to Claude Code and justify every service choice.

nodes._section: GAME DEV (C#) BRANCH — shared core then Unity / Godot

nodes.label: C# for Games
nodes.summary: Engine-agnostic foundations: the game loop, delta time, 2D vectors & math, input handling, state machines, collision basics. Trace these in Facet's lenses.

nodes.label: Game loop & delta time
nodes.summary: Update/render loop, frame independence, fixed vs variable timestep.

nodes.label: Vectors & 2D math
nodes.summary: Position/velocity, normalize, dot product, lerp — the math every game needs.

nodes.label: Input & state machines
nodes.summary: Input polling, a simple FSM for game/entity state (idle/run/jump).

nodes.label: Collision basics
nodes.summary: AABB / circle overlap tests, spatial reasoning.

nodes.label: PICK ENGINE
nodes.summary: Same C#, two engines. Unity = industry standard, biggest job market, paid tiers. Godot = free/OSS, great 2D, but C# can't export to web yet. Learn one deeply, or both.

nodes.label: Unity Basics
nodes.summary: Unity 6 editor, GameObjects, components, MonoBehaviour lifecycle, the C# scripting model.

nodes.label: Editor & GameObjects
nodes.summary: Scenes, hierarchy, inspector, prefabs.

nodes.label: MonoBehaviour lifecycle
nodes.summary: Awake/Start/Update/FixedUpdate, serialized fields.

nodes.label: Physics & input
nodes.summary: Rigidbody, colliders, the Input System.

nodes.label: Gameplay systems
nodes.summary: Spawning, scoring, game state, ScriptableObjects.

nodes.summary: CharacterBody2D, areas, input map.

nodes.summary: Spawning, scoring, autoloads/singletons, state.
